plaatsen.tekst: Therefore they shall come and sing in the height of Zion, and shall flow together to the goodness of the LORD, for wheat, and for wine, and for oil, and for the young of the flock and of the herd: and their soul shall be as a watered garden; and they shall not sorrow any more
For I have satiated the weary soul, and I have replenished every sorrowful soul.
Mine eye mourneth by reason of affliction: LORD, I have called daily upon thee, I have stretched out my hands
